widgets.title: Hero banner
widgets.description: Your name drawn on stroke by stroke, a typewriter cycling through your roles and an orbiting emblem.

options.label: Typewriter roles
options.help: Cycles through the roles from your profile.

options.label: Greeting line
options.help: Time-of-day greeting, date and moon phase.

widgets.title: Statement banner
widgets.description: A big typographic statement with a subline, brought to life by a gradient sweep, an outline draw-on, a letter-by-letter rise or a marquee.

options.label: Headline
options.help: Placeholders: {name} {login} {city} {company} {role} {year} {followers} {stars} {repos} {streak} {contributions} {project} {repo} {tagline} {version} {license} {forks} {contributors} {npm} {pypi} {crate} {owner}

options.label: Subline
options.default: Developer tools, typed APIs and small interfaces that feel good to use.

options.label: Corner marks
options.help: Small registration ticks in the corners.

widgets.title: Project hero
widgets.description: Your project's name drawn on, its tagline, version, install command and headline numbers over an ambient glow.

options.label: Version pill
options.help: Latest release tag next to the name.

options.label: Install command
options.help: Shown in a code pill under the tagline. Leave empty to hide. Placeholders: {npm} {repo} {project} {version}

options.label: Emblem icon
options.help: Defaults to the project logo; without one a monogram tile is drawn.

widgets.title: Social pills
widgets.description: One animated, clickable pill per profile link. Each is its own image so every link works.

widgets.title: Terminal
widgets.description: A shell session that types out commands about you, with live placeholders, syntax colours and a tmux-style status bar.

item.label: Output
item.help: One line per row. Colours: {a}accent {m}muted {s}string {n}number {b}bold {/}reset. Placeholders: {name} {login} {city} {company} {role} {year} {age} {days_alive} {account_age} {followers} {stars} {repos} {streak} {year_pct} {stack}. Wrap text in {? … ?} to hide it when a placeholder is empty.

options.label: Status text
options.help: Supports the same placeholders, plus {clock}, {time}, {date} and {tz}.

widgets.title: Tech stack orbit
widgets.description: Your tools as a little solar system: up to three rings of brand icons orbiting a centre emblem.

options.label: Ring legend
options.help: Lists each ring's tools beside the orbit.

item.label: Icons
item.help: Icon ids such as typescript, react, docker. Inner rings hold fewer icons than outer ones.

widgets.title: About card
widgets.description: A typographic introduction: monogram, name and pronouns, your roles, a short bio and chips for where you work and live.

options.label: Bio
options.help: Up to five lines; a blank line starts a new paragraph. Placeholders: {name} {login} {city} {company} {role} {year} {followers} {stars} {repos} {streak} {contributions} {project} {repo} {tagline} {version} {license} {forks} {contributors} {npm} {pypi} {crate} {owner}

options.label: Monogram
options.help: Your initials in an accent disc.

widgets.title: Quick facts
widgets.description: A tidy key-value list of things worth knowing about you, revealed row by row, in one or two columns.

options.label: Dotted leaders
options.help: A dotted line between each key and its value.

item.label: Icon
item.help: A brand icon, or a line glyph such as pin, briefcase, code, book, heart, rocket, globe.

widgets.title: Badges
widgets.description: A row of shields-style badges drawn right in the image, no third-party service, wrapping neatly across lines.

options.label: Value colour
options.help: Brand uses each icon's own colour; a per-badge colour always wins.

item.label: Icon
item.help: Brand icon or line glyph; leave empty for none.

widgets.title: Skill meters
widgets.description: Your strongest tools as filling bars, segmented blocks or radial gauges, each with its icon and level.

widgets.title: Timeline
widgets.description: Experience and education on a vertical rail whose nodes light up one after another, with a live pulse on what you do now.

options.label: Live pulse on the first entry
options.help: Marks the top entry as what you are doing now.

default.title: Senior Software Engineer

default.title: Full-stack Developer

default.title: BSc Computer Science

widgets.title: Contact card
widgets.description: A “let's work together” card with your availability, a short pitch and up to three call-to-action buttons.

options.label: Headline
options.help: Placeholders: {name} {login} {city} {company} {role} {year} {followers} {stars} {repos} {streak} {contributions} {project} {repo} {tagline} {version} {license} {forks} {contributors} {npm} {pypi} {crate} {owner}

options.label: Text
options.default: I'm taking on a few freelance and open-source collaborations this season. Drop me a line and I'll usually reply within a day.

options.label: Buttons
options.help: Buttons are drawn into the image; the whole card links to the URL below.

options.label: Link
options.help: mailto:, a booking page or any URL.

options.label: Emblem
options.help: Shown inside the signal on the right.

widgets.title: Local time
widgets.description: A live clock for your time zone that keeps ticking after the build, with your city, UTC offset and today's daylight band.

options.label: Daylight band
options.help: Approximate sunrise and sunset from your profile location.

widgets.title: Shields
widgets.description: Shield-style badges for version, licence, build status, stars, downloads and more, each its own image linking to the right page.

options.label: Style
options.help: Large is shields.io's “for the badge” look: taller, in capitals.

options.label: Value colour
options.help: Build status always uses green, amber or red.

widgets.title: Contributor wall
widgets.description: Everyone who has committed to the project as a wall of avatars that pop in one by one, top contributors first.

options.label: Names
options.help: Login under each avatar.

widgets.title: Support & sponsor
widgets.description: A warm call to action for sponsors: headline, a short pitch, up to three drawn buttons (GitHub Sponsors, Ko-fi, Open Collective, …) and a beating heart.

options.label: Headline
options.help: Placeholders: {name} {login} {city} {company} {role} {year} {followers} {stars} {repos} {streak} {contributions} {project} {repo} {tagline} {version} {license} {forks} {contributors} {npm} {pypi} {crate} {owner}

options.label: Buttons
options.help: Drawn into the image; the card links to the first button's URL. URLs default to your account on each platform ({owner} is the repository owner).

options.label: Backers line
options.default: Thank you to everyone who already chips in.
options.help: A short line under the buttons, e.g. how many people back the work.

widgets.title: Stats board
widgets.description: Rolling odometer counters for your key numbers, with an optional year-progress ring.

options.label: Tiles
options.help: Up to 6 with the ring, 8 without.

widgets.title: Top languages
widgets.description: Your most used languages by bytes of code, as an animated donut, bar list or stacked bar.

options.label: Languages shown
options.help: The rest are grouped as Other.

widgets.title: Achievements
widgets.description: Hexagonal trophies that unlock in three tiers as your streaks, stars and years on GitHub grow.

widgets.title: Streak card
widgets.description: Current streak in a burning ring, flanked by your longest run and total contributions, each with its date range.

options.label: Date ranges
options.help: Show when each streak started and ended.

options.label: Record ring
options.help: The ring fills as your current streak approaches your longest.

widgets.title: Language donut
widgets.description: Your languages as a donut that draws itself in, with the top language in the centre and a percentage legend.

options.label: Max slices
options.help: Smaller languages are grouped as Other.

widgets.title: Year in review
widgets.description: Your year, wrapped: total contributions, busiest month, best day, favourite weekday and more, over a monthly bar chart.

options.label: Highlights
options.help: Up to six, shown in a 3 × 2 grid.

options.label: Pace & comparison
options.help: Projected total and change against last year.

widgets.title: Follower milestone
widgets.description: Your follower count on a rolling counter with a progress bar towards the next milestone.

options.label: Milestone ladder
options.help: Small markers for the milestones around you.

widgets.title: Repository stats

options.label: Tiles
options.help: Up to 6 with the ring, 8 without.

options.label: Health ring
options.help: Share of issues closed, with pull requests merged as an inner ring.

widgets.title: Repository vitals
widgets.description: A compact health check: build status with a live pulse, last commit, latest release, issue and pull request balance, and the licence.

options.label: Registry
options.help: Package names come from the project settings.

widgets.title: Contribution graph
widgets.description: Your last 12 months as an animated heatmap with a scanning beam, best-day callout and weekly totals.

options.label: Label

options.label: BPM tile

widgets.title: 3D skyline

options.label: Weekday strip

options.label: Summary line
options.help: Chronotype, peak hour and daily average.

widgets.title: Journey timeline
widgets.description: Your years on GitHub as a timeline: contributions per year above the axis, repositories you started below.

options.label: Label

options.label: Years

options.label: Flap animation

widgets.title: Contribution trend

widgets.title: Star history

options.label: Milestone flags

widgets.title: Commit activity
widgets.description: A year of weekly commits as growing bars, a heat strip or a line, with the busiest week called out and the latest commit underneath.

options.label: Latest commit

options.label: Repository

options.label: Activity sparkline
options.help: Your contributions over the last 30 days.

options.label: Lifetime bar
options.help: How long the repository has existed, from first commit to now.

options.label: Position

options.label: Big number
options.help: Watermark with the slot number.

widgets.title: Top repositories
widgets.description: Your best or most recently pushed repositories with descriptions, languages and rolling star counters.

options.label: Hide profile README repo

options.label: Release titles

options.label: Card link

widgets.title: Markdown text
widgets.description: Free-form Markdown or HTML written straight into your README, with live placeholders like {name} and {followers}.

options.label: Markdown
options.default:
Hi, I'm **{name}**. I build calm, fast software and the tools around it.
Currently exploring local-first apps and typed APIs. Say hello any time!
options.help: Emitted verbatim into the README; the row's alignment applies. Placeholders: {name} {login} {city} {company} {role} {year} {followers} {stars} {repos} {streak} {contributions} {project} {repo} {tagline} {version} {license} {forks} {contributors} {npm} {pypi} {crate} {owner}

widgets.title: Install command
widgets.description: A terminal that types your install command, cycling through package-manager tabs, with a copy button and an optional quick-start line.

options.label: Package managers
options.help: One tab each, typed in turn. Package names come from the project settings and fall back to the repository name.

options.label: Quick-start line
options.help: A follow-up command such as `npx {npm} init`.

options.label: Quick-start command
options.help: Same command on every tab. Placeholders: {npm} {pypi} {crate} {bin} {repo}.

options.label: Custom commands
options.help: Shown as extra tabs when Custom is ticked. An entry labelled like a ticked manager (npm, pip, …) replaces that tab's command.

widgets.title: Code snippet
widgets.description: A syntax-highlighted code card with a file tab, line numbers, highlighted lines and a line-by-line reveal: perfect for a usage example.

options.label: Code
options.help: Placeholders: {npm} {pypi} {crate} {bin} {repo} {project} {version}. Up to 36 rows are shown.

options.label: Highlight lines
options.help: Line numbers or ranges to emphasise.

widgets.title: Feature grid
widgets.description: Your project's highlights as a two- or three-column grid of icon tiles, titles and short descriptions, revealed one by one.

options.label: Title
options.help: Placeholders: {name} {login} {city} {company} {role} {year} {followers} {stars} {repos} {streak} {contributions} {project} {repo} {tagline} {version} {license} {forks} {contributors} {npm} {pypi} {crate} {owner}

options.label: Numbered
options.help: Adds 01, 02, … to each feature.

default.text: First-class TypeScript types and autocompletion for every option and plugin hook.

default.text: Readable errors, coloured diffs and a watch mode that stays out of your way.

default.title: Runs anywhere
